logp.method_description: The measurement of log P for complexes I and II were carried out following a modified procedure [32]. Briefly, ca. 0.5 mg of cis-[Ru(phen)2(4-bzpy)(Cl)](PF6) (I) or cis-[Ru(phen)2(4-bzpy)(Cl)](PF6) (II) complex was dissolved in 1 mL of water. Then, n-octanol (1 mL) was added, and the mixture was shaken for ca. 8 h in a thermomixer at 28 °C and 1400 rpm. The samples were then centrifuged at 4300 rpm for 10 min to separate the aqueous phase from the organic phase. The lower phase (aqueous phase) was aspirated using a glass syringe. Then, the UV–Vis absorption spectrum was obtained for this phase and used to quantify the compound concentration, whose concentration in the organic phase was calculated as the difference from its initial value. Previously, the molar absorptivity of metal complexes was measured in an aqueous medium (Complex I: λ = 265 nm, ε = 5.9 × 10–4 L mol-1 cm-1; Complex II: λ = 290 nm, ε = 4.9 × 10–4 L mol-1 cm-1) and used for quantification. LogP values were calculated using the following formula: log P = log (Coctanol/Cwater).
